sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Spanish-BigMed-Large-560M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Spanish text.

sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Spanish-BigMed-Large-560M-v1-mlx
sources.snippet: This model identifies personal and health information (PII/PHI) in Spanish medical documents by labelling tokens such as names, dates, locations and ID numbers, enabling records to be de-identified. It is an MLX-converted 560M-parameter transformer for Spanish biomedical text, aimed at developers and health-data teams working on clinical NLP pipelines. View on Modelers ↗ 6 Quality score

sources.snippet: The model is part of the OpenMed family and is hosted on Modelers.cn, the Huawei/Ascend AI ecosystem platform. Its 560M-parameter encoder makes it a relatively large model for this task, intended to capture the complexity of Spanish biomedical language.
